patches.name: Fix Flonase crash
patches.note: Guards the render method (FUN_00b8bf0c) against a garbage (1) object pointer so Flonase no longer SEGVs on trigger.

patches.name: Fixed powerup spawn rate
patches.note: Forces the powerup pace bag to a constant N pieces (1 powerup per N pieces ~= 100/N %/piece), ignoring the JSON value and Daily-Challenge overrides. Patches both board constructors.

patches.name: Remove on-board powerup cap
patches.note: Removes the per-type on-board powerup limit (FUN_00f4e9dc cur<max gate) so the generator never returns 'no powerup'. Pair with a high spawn rate to saturate the matrix. Turns b.lt into an unconditional branch, skipping the -1.
